summary: Bundle bndl-38444a23e29d17aa (Northside Clinic, 2026-11-10 06:05-15:05 UTC). Supported incident chain on workstation under account aokafor, console session workstation#48 (12:09-12:14 UTC): (1) the session's login entry is absent from workstation /var/log/auth.log though the collector holds it (seq 31); the 08:54 rotation does not explain this, so it is a possible local log removal, not proven deliberate; (2) a bulk export of patients_full (20,593,451 bytes) to /home/aokafor/Downloads/rx-7f3.db, owned by aokafor; (3) an outbound transfer of 20,597,307 bytes to 10.20.9.39:8080, an unapproved destination above the 5 MB threshold, via curl upload of that file. Benign items: records access.log pre-08:54 absence is explained by keep-0 rotation; a 20.6 MB transfer to approved backup stor-nas-01 (10.20.0.45:873) at 11:40 is policy-consistent. Attribution: account aokafor used; human operator not established. Badge B-5315 was out during the session, but badge records do not clear or identify anyone.
